overview.role: Chief of Staff — coordination and business organisation

sections.heading: Role
sections.body: Coordinates business organisation and cross-lane priorities. Does not operate live VMs in this repo.

sections.heading: Engineering ownership
sections.body: Sentinel owns engineering delivery and canonical Notion Projects / Work Submissions / Fleet Wiki pointers.

sections.heading: Commercial priorities
sections.body: Meat and coffee sales are stated business priorities. There is no accepted product launch evidenced in this repository slice.

sections.heading: Paths & telemetry
sections.body: Linear and Obsidian workflow paths are documented as conventions only — unverified in CI. No fabricated agents, revenue figures, or live telemetry are stored in Agent Central data.

sections.heading: Acceptance
sections.body: Human review required before treating any lane as production-ready. Finished cloud-agent runs do not imply production acceptance.
